main_body: Leafy tree canopy (about rows 0-34) on a short brown trunk, with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: No flat top surface. The canopy mass shades from lighter green (L~111, #49804c) at the upper rows 3-15 to darker clumps (L~50-60) below, then the trunk starts at row 31
evidence: This is a volumetric organic canopy, not a flat-surfaced object. Light falls on the upper canopy, and the lower leaf mass is darker and shades the trunk top (dark run at rows 30-33 in column x=16). The trunk is a short vertical stem with a base. There is no side face, no flat elevation panel and no top-down slab, so the 3/4 contract is acceptable for an organic tree. The top and front-edge counts are loose estimates because a canopy has no true top band.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 13 distinct colours and a median of 6 per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours for the references. The leaf clumps are blocky 2-4 px patches in about 5 greens, with none of the per-leaf highlights, bright rim accents or branch detail the references carry. The outline is a tinted dark green with no neutral edge pixels, and there are no 5x5 flat fills. Even so, the canopy is much thinner than the Beodeul trees in colour variety and texture, the trunk is a plain 2-tone column, and the grass patch is simple.
